story_type: lava flow creeping across lawns toward a town
hook: Lava, crawling across a backyard lawn in Hawaii.
narration: This is lava crawling across a backyard lawn in Hawaii.
It was the Puna lava flow, edging toward the town of Pahoa on the Big Island.
This kind of lava is called pahoehoe. A black crust cools on top, and the molten rock inside keeps pushing through it.
Wherever it touched green grass, the grass went up in smoke.
New breakouts kept bursting from the back and the edges of the flow.
outcome: The main front closest to Pahoa stalled, but the flow behind it stayed active.
title: Lava crawls across a Hawaii lawn
description:
In November 2014 the Puna lava flow from Kilauea advanced toward the town of Pahoa on Hawaii Island. The main front closest to Pahoa stalled while breakouts continued along the rear and edges of the flow.

Footage: U.S. Army National Guard video by Staff Sgt. Katie Gray, 117th Mobile Public Affairs Detachment (Hawaii), via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/371353/puna-lava-flow-b-roll
